notes.title: Winter Update
notes.notes:
Hey,
We made a winter update, so you can feel that winter is coming!

[b]What we added:[/b]
[list]
[*]Snow a lot of snow on every map, so you can feel winter atmosphere but stay warm inside of the house
[*]Cloudy weather
[*]Bug fixes mostly related to FPS drops, so now game runs faster
[/list] 

[url=https://discord.gg/An8ecxGq]JOIN OUR DISCORD[/url]

Thanks!

notes.title: STREETOIR RELEASE
notes.notes:
We are happy to introduce you to the full experience of our game, after 3 month of hard work, we are finally releasing our first game, the game is going to be updated with new content and fixes of previous problems, so we wanted to thank everyone who helped us on this journey, and it's only beginning!!!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44699543/bf30301dab46b26c40f691f91e633794980e3df6.png[/img]

notes.title: Streetoir release date
notes.notes:
[h1]Streetoir[/h1]
Is finally going to release, we been working hard on our game and spent a lot of time, and now our dream comes true, but without players help and feedback we would never be so close to our dream, thanks and [b][h3]Streetoir will be released at 14 of November[/h3] [/b]
